import urllib.request, json, time

# Fetch first post for top 30 topics to assess problem statement clarity
top_ids = [86, 334, 1162, 12241, 751, 1096, 247, 5021, 4411, 12105, 1093, 792, 12736, 722, 765, 26273, 1191, 717, 14136, 9524, 9076, 4261, 9020, 4058, 6924, 12241, 5021, 4411]

for tid in top_ids[:30]:
    url = f'https://community.anovaculinary.com/t/{tid}.json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'E091-protocol/1.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            data = json.load(resp)
        posts = data['post_stream']['posts']
        first_post = posts[0]['cooked'][:300]
        # Strip HTML tags roughly
        import re
        text = re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', first_post)
        text = re.sub('\s+', ' ', text).strip()
        print(f'ID: {tid:5d} | {text[:200]}')
        print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ID: {tid:5d} | ERROR: {e}')
    time.sleep(0.3)

import urllib.request, json, time, re

# The 20 candidate topics for the population
pop_ids = [86, 12241, 1096, 5021, 12736, 722, 26273, 717, 4261, 9020, 6924, 132, 4681, 12987, 9165, 3051, 8811, 10550, 13044, 5115, 659]

# Fetch full first post and check last few posts for resolution
for tid in pop_ids:
    url = f'https://community.anovaculinary.com/t/{tid}.json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'E091-protocol/1.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            data = json.load(resp)
        posts = data['post_stream']['posts']
        first_post = posts[0]['cooked']
        text = re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', first_post)
        text = re.sub('\s+', ' ', text).strip()
        
        # Check last 3 posts for resolution indicators
        last_posts = posts[-3:] if len(posts) >= 3 else posts
        last_text = ' '.join([re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', p['cooked']) for p in last_posts])
        last_text = re.sub('\s+', ' ', last_text).strip()[:500]
        
        print(f'ID: {tid:5d} | Title: {data["title"][:60]}')
        print(f'  First: {text[:150]}')
        print(f'  Last: {last_text[:150]}')
        print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ID: {tid:5d} | ERROR: {e}')
    time.sleep(0.3)
